description: Creates a Google Calendar web intent link and an RFC 5545 .ics calendar file. Use when the user wants to schedule a meeting, create a calendar invite, or export dates. Accepts title, start date or date-time, duration or end time, time zone, location, description, and reminder minutes. Returns a Google Calendar link and standard .ics text ready to import into any calendar. Nothing is stored and no calendar is modified automatically.

description.description: Event agenda, notes, or participant details.

duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes if end date-time is omitted (for example, 30 or 60).

end.description: Optional end date or date-time in the same format as start.

location.description: Meeting room, street address, or video call URL.

reminder_minutes.description: Minutes before the event to trigger an alarm/reminder (for example, 10 or 15).

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD for all-day) or start date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, add Z, offset, or timezone).

timezone.description: IANA time zone name (such as America/New_York, Europe/Paris, Asia/Tokyo).

name: create_calendar_event

filename.description: Suggested file name for the .ics file.

google_calendar_url.description: Google Calendar web intent link with pre-populated fields.

url_length.description: Length of the Google Calendar URL.

warning.description: Warning if URL exceeds safe limits.

title: Create calendar event
